title: Normal operation and user expectation snippets
summary: This topic groups short fragments about normal behavior, preferences, and usage expectations, with limited evidence of a single clearly positive remark and several items whose sentiment cannot be determined from the excerpt alone.

positive.summary: The positive review expresses a customer preference for ordering a blue car.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mention expected coasting behavior, needing a longer cable for plugged-in use, and a restart occurring normally, but the excerpts do not reveal clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: The topic appears to mix unrelated subjects such as color preference, driving behavior expectations, cable length, and restart status.
Most excerpts are very short and lack enough context to determine customer sentiment confidently.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews on this topic.
